visuals.caption_fil: Apat itong pagbabago, at magkakaugnay — kinakalikot nito kung paano dumadaan ang isang tao mula sa pangangailangan patungo sa serbisyo.
visuals.caption_en: Four connected changes — together they shape how a person moves from a need to actually receiving service.
visuals.alt_text_fil: Chain na dayagram na may apat na kahon sunod-sunod: PhilHealth (awtomatikong saklaw), Outpatient (saklaw na rin ng PhilHealth), Primary Care (may nakatalagang provider), at Referral (mas malinaw na daloy).
visuals.alt_text_en: Chain diagram with four boxes in sequence: PhilHealth (automatic coverage), Outpatient (now also covered by PhilHealth), Primary Care (assigned provider), and Referral (a clearer pathway).
